acquisition_method.evidence: All spectra were acquired on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) operated in data-independent mode (DIA) coupled to an Ultimate3000 liquid chromatography system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and separated on a 50 cm reversed phase column packed in-house (Poroshell EC-C18, 2.7 μm, 50 cm × 75 μm; Agilent Technologies).
experiment types: Data-independent acquisition; Bottom-up proteomics

alkylation_concentration.evidence: 24 μL of a detergent-based buffer (1% sodium deoxycholate (SDC), 10 mM tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine (TCEP), 10 mM Tris, and 40 mM chloroacetamide) with Complete mini EDTA-free protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche) was added to 1 μL of plasma and boiled for 5 min at 95 °C to enhance protein denaturation.

cleavage_agent.evidence: 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate was added, and digestion was allowed to proceed overnight at 37 °C using trypsin (Promega) and LysC (Wako) at 1:50 and 1:75 enzyme:substrate ratios, respectively.

fractionation_method.evidence: The fractions with molecular weight between ∼1 kDa and ∼2 MDa were selected for analysis from all time points of all samples, cumulating in to 66 fractions per time point.

fragmentation_method.evidence: DIA runs consisted of a MS1 scan at 60,000 resolution at m/z 200 followed by 30 sequential quadrupole isolation windows of 20 m/z for HCD MS/MS with detection of fragment ions in the Orbitrap (OT) at 30,000 resolution at m/z 200.
